source.description:
Ella Chen’s Playful Elegance

Ella Chen graces the ELLE Taiwan cover in a sheer pastel ensemble, holding a pink anthurium flower over one eye. Her wet-look hair and minimalist styling create a fresh, modern portrait that balances softness with editorial flair. The translucent top and gentle color palette highlight her playful yet sophisticated presence.

source.description:
Ella Chen’s Monochrome Vogue Portrait

Ella Chen appears in a striking black ensemble, styled with a high-collar jacket, leather shorts, and a chunky chain necklace. Her hand rests thoughtfully on her cheek, highlighting her composed gaze and smooth, pulled-back hair. The neutral gray background and soft lighting emphasize the clean lines of her outfit and the editorial quality of the shot.

source.title: 【封面人物】Ella陳嘉樺走紅近20年，從未因名氣而"走失"，「到現在還有工作來找我，對我來說都是我的福氣！」 | Bella.tw儂儂
source.description:
Ella Chen appears in a sleek black suit and diamond accessories for Bella.tw’s August 2020 cover story. In one shot she gazes directly at the camera with wind-swept hair, and in another she sits contemplatively beneath a mirror, highlighting her effortless elegance and strong presence.

The feature article celebrates her 19-year career since debuting with S.H.E, her boundless energy on and off stage, and her journey balancing life as an artist, wife, and mother. Styled by Saint Laurent and Dior with jewelry by Piaget, the portraits capture both her refined fashion sense and her warm, authentic personality.
